title: Bulletproof Host Virtualine Loses Its Domain to FBI Seizure
description: The FBI seized the domain virtualine.net, used by Virtualine, a Russian-speaking bulletproof hosting provider that supported various cybercriminal activities including hack-for-hire services, ransomware, infostealers, phishing, spam, and carding. Despite law enforcement takedown requests, Virtualine continued aiding illicit customers and hosting illegal content. The provider received significant cryptocurrency payments linked to criminal operations such as drug marketplaces, sextortion schemes, and ransomware groups. Domain seizure disrupts access but does not guarantee cessation of the operator's activities or loss of infrastructure access.
